rows.statement: Vercel positions itself as purpose-built for secure development

sides.text: Purpose-built for secure development, Vercel allows you to build, deploy, and protect applications with our suite of security features.
On April 19, 2026, Vercel disclosed a security breach in which certain internal systems were accessed by unauthorized actors.

rows.statement: Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 is callable through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key, no provider account needed

sides.text: Call Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key: no provider account, fallbacks, spend tracking, and traces on every request.

rows.statement: GLM-5.3 via DigitalOcean is 50% off on AI Gateway until September 7

sides.text: GLM-5.3 served by DigitalOcean is 50% off on Vercel AI Gateway through September 7.

rows.statement: Basic build machines (2 vCPU, 8 GB) available on Pro and Enterprise

sides.text: Pro and Enterprise teams can now select Basic build machines, 2 vCPU and 8 GB, a lower-cost option for smaller apps. New projects still default to Elastic.

rows.statement: Notion runs millions of agent conversations daily on Vercel

sides.text: Notion powers millions of agent conversations daily on Vercel.

rows.statement: Pro free-domain offer covers eight TLDs including .app and .dev, one domain free for the first year

sides.text: The free domain with Pro offer now covers .app and .dev, bringing the eligible TLDs to eight. Every Pro team can claim one domain, free for the first year.

rows.statement: Vercel managed rulesets protect against OWASP Top 10 risks

sides.text: Activate Vercel’s managed rulesets to protect against top priority risks, including OWASP Top 10.

rows.statement: Pro includes a monthly usage credit plus pay-as-you-go billing for extra consumption

sides.text: For Teams on the Pro plan, a monthly usage credit applies to billable resources. After applicable included allowances and credit, Vercel bills usage on demand.

rows.statement: Cursor Cloud Agents can run on Vercel Sandbox with scale-to-zero workers and isolated microVMs

sides.text: Run Cursor Cloud Agents on infrastructure you control with Vercel Sandbox, using scale-to-zero workers, isolated microVMs, and durable orchestration.

rows.statement: Vercel WAF supports custom rules to log, block, challenge, or rate limit L7 traffic

sides.text: Vercel’s Web Application Firewall allows customers to create custom rules to log, block, challenge, or rate limit L7 traffic.
